extraction.Name: Thomas Bridgeman
extraction.Refused/Protested: Well I told several people in the dance hall about this time that those that are physically fit it might be all right but I am not in a condition to make my way.
extraction.Recorded patent: I got it from the Rosebud Agency
extraction.Occupation/Income: I farm some and we get some trust funds occasionally.
extraction.NOTES: Thomas Bridgeman states he did not ask for this patent and that 'any doctor will tell you that in my condition I should not have received one.' He has been crippled for nearly 50 years and is in poor health. Sale price was approximately $1800 cash with no debts in the case. Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on April 8, 1929.
